name: Meridian Industrial Equipment
figuresNote: Fictional company. Profile figures are illustrative.
descriptor: Mid-market OEM that sells and services commercial industrial equipment, with a large installed base under service contracts.
today: Service runs on a 15-year-old legacy dispatch system, spreadsheets, and a separate warranty tool.
ambition: Service leadership wants service treated as a margin line.
painPoints: Contract entitlements are not enforced in the field.
Parts get pulled off the truck without being billed.
Invoicing is slow after the job is complete.
First-time fix is low because technicians lack asset history.
